BiblicalUsage: The word is continually, constantly, in Aramaic. Darius says to Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, He will deliver thee, and in the morning the king cries with a lamentable voice, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the king noticed what Daniel did continually, and the God served without stopping is the God who delivers.
